Their intersection defines the reconciled output, which is critical for ensuring no data is missed. The status lattice tracks four distinct states—found, processed, wired, tested—forming a Boolean lattice that enables precise filtering of data readiness. Each signal in the registry must satisfy eight criteria to be considered compliant; this is modeled as a multi-criterion decision space. Failure occurs when the lattice fails to converge or when compliance indices fall below thresholds, indicating systemic gaps in data readiness or signal fidelity.
